senses.gloss: pitcher for drawing water for drinking or hand-washing.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 17:6">Sabb. XVII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 125b">125ᵇ</cite>), v. <cite ref="G00511"><he>זְמוֹרָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 63a">B. Bath. 63ᵃ</cite> ‘give him a share in my well <he>לט׳</he> Ms. M. a. Rashb. (ed. <he>לטפיחי</he>, corr. acc.; Ms. F. <he>לטַפְיָא</he>, cmp. <cite ref="I00646"><he>טָפִי</he></cite>) for the pitcher’, i.e. for drinking purposes.

<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 4:11">Tosef. Ber. IV, 11</cite> [read as] <cite ref="Yoma 30a:4">Yoma 30ᵃ</cite> <he>ומחזיר הט׳ על האורחים</he> (v. Rashi a. l.; Ms. M. <he>והט׳ חוזר וכ׳</he>) and passes the pitcher (which he had used for washing his hands) around the guests.

senses.gloss: a pitcher-shaped vessel put up in walls and cornices as bird’s nest.—Pl. טְפִיחִים, טְפִיחִין.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 24a:15">Bets. 24ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Beitzah 25a:6">25ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:2">Tosef. Sabb. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:4">XIII</cite>), 4; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 18:4">ib. XVIII, 4</cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>טפחין</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 18:4">ib.</cite>

senses.gloss: muddy soil, ground on which water subsided, opp. to גריד.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:7">Gen. R. s. 33</cite>, end (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 56:7">Yalk. ib. 56</cite> <cite ref="M02436"><he>מקפה</he></cite>).
